name: engineering-board
description: The board is the database: a git-committed kanban board your AI agents run and remember — distributed as a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server.

plugins.name: engineering-board
plugins.description: Git-committed pattern intelligence for engineering agents. Findings remain visible Markdown evidence, deterministic graph structure connects recurring signals across domains, and bounded hypotheses help agents investigate shared root causes without treating correlation as confirmation. Includes passive capture, durable learnings, atomic multi-agent claims, an optional tdd->review->validate proof loop, and a zero-dependency 12-tool MCP server over the same board format.
